classification.countingRule: One discipline per active task; retain original labels and classify the four November 4 replacement tasks by their research contracts.

metric.name: Normalized score
metric.description: Normalize each task, clip negative scores to zero, then sum and divide by all 104 benchmark tasks. No upper cap. Collection filters retain the benchmark denominator. Agent failures contribute zero; missing and undefined task scores are disclosed in coverage.
